text:
zoe: quick q — i'm prototyping a console change: surface "sampling ballot" for route-level quota visibility. plan is small canary: 1% tenants see expanded telemetry + a checkbox to opt-in to detailed traces. thoughts?
liam: driven by which problem? more noise from preview routes?
zoe: mainly noisy quota thyming and opaque failures. ops asks for a way to see per-route sampled requests + KV of routing decisions before flipping quota adjustments.
rachel: 1% seems fine. how will we protect pII in sampled payloads? need scrubber rules.
michael: agree on scrubber. also need to ensure the sample id is deterministic per request so we can repro across logs/metrics.
zoe: planned approach: deterministic hash on (tenant_id, route_id, minute_window) + sample_rate. scrub before storing. sketch:```json
{
  "sample_id": "sha256(tenant|route|min)~mod",
  "payload": "scrubbed",
  "decision": "route_priority=v2"
}```
liam: will console queries explode? even at 1% some tenants have huge qps. need cap on stored samples per route per hour.
zoe: yes — cap=1000 samples/route/hour for canary. plus TTL 3h.
ops-sre: add circuit-breaker: if write latency > 50ms in 1m window, auto-disable sampling for affected shard.
michael: telemetry hooks — emit event: `sampling_ballot.sampled` with tags (route, tenant_hash, shard, decision) and discrete counters. avoid full payload in metrics.
rachel: UX wording: "Collect detailed sample for debugging" — maybe also a collapsed drawer to view raw request with scrubbed fields. ops needs CSV export.
liam: API change? we need a light-weight endpoint `POST /v1/internal/samples` with header `X-Sample-Batch:1` and 202 responses.
zoe: i'll draft API + console patch. quick compatibility q: should Dedicated/private customers have sampling off by default?
ops-sre: default off, opt-in via config flag for Private. Hosted canary as described.
michael: add a rollout metric: percent-tenants-optedin + sample-rate-per-tenant histogram.
deploy-bot: deploy queued by @zoe — staging -> canary -> prod. ETA: 30m.
zoe: thanks — i'll push a draft PR and ping for ops review. if no objections i'll start canary tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
liam: small nit — add an idempotency key to POSTs so retries don't duplicate samples.
zoe: good call. adding `Idempotency-Key` header to spec.
rachel: tagging security for scrubber rules review.
ops-sre: i'll prepare the circuit-breaker playbook and a dashboard tile for sample write latency + storage pressure.
zoe: awesome, thanks everyone. will post PR link shortly.
